scripts.build:packages: rm -rf dist && cd ../../packages && rm -rf dist && bun run build && cd ../examples/fake-api
scripts.build:css: bunx postcss src/{,**/}*.css --dir dist --minify && bunx tailwindcss --input src/global.css --output src/.tailwindcss.txt --minify
scripts.dev: bun run build:packages && bun run build:css && bun build src/{,**/}*.ts --outdir dist --splitting --hot --entry-naming [name].[ext] --chunk-naming [name]-[hash].[ext] && bun run --hot app.ts
scripts.build: bun run build:packages && bun run build:css && bun build src/{,**/}*.ts --outdir dist --splitting --minify --entry-naming [name].[ext] --chunk-naming [name]-[hash].[ext] && bun run --minify app.ts
